packageDetails: A 245-horsepower (248 PS; 183 kW) 2.0-liter EcoBoost inline-four is the standard engine, with a 335-horsepower (340 PS; 250 kW) 2.7-liter EcoBoost V6 carried over from the MKX as an option; both engines are fitted with start-stop capability.

Packages: All Nautilus models are all-wheel drive and have transverse-mounted engines.
packageDetails: All Nautilus models are all-wheel drive and have transverse-mounted engines. The standard Nautilus achieves 21, 29 and 24 mpg‑US (11.2, 8.1 and 9.8 L/100 km; 25, 35 and 29 mpg‑imp) on the EPA's city, highway, and combined cycles, respectively, while with hybrid power it gets 30, 31 and 30 mpg‑US (7.8, 7.6 and 7.8 L/100 km; 36, 37 and 36 mpg‑imp) on the same rating system.
